title: RC Low-Pass Filter Model
constraints: `TAU` and `TS` are `real` parameters / generics in seconds, with defaults 1.0e-6 and 10.0e-9.
Update once per rising edge of `clk`: `vout += (vin - vout) * (1 - exp(-TS/TAU))`.
`vout` starts at 0.0. Results must match the exact recurrence within 1e-9 V.
The model does not need to be synthesizable.
hints: `alpha = 1 - exp(-TS/TAU)` is constant. Compute it once as a `localparam real` / `constant`.
In VHDL, keep the filter state in an internal `real` signal and assign it to `vout`.

examples.title: unit step
examples.input: vin steps 0 → 1.0, TAU = 1 µs, TS = 10 ns

examples.title: discharge
examples.input: vin = 1.0 for 300 more steps, then -0.5 for 400 steps
examples.expected: vout settles near 1.0, then decays toward -0.5

wave_windows.caption: vout approaches vin exponentially: 63 % after one time constant.
